verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce documents only a thin post-purchase capability: it can 'Confirm payment outcomes and trigger post-purchase actions in real-time.' That covers payment-side status after a purchase, but nothing in the pack describes querying order or fulfillment status or shipment tracking. Missing for 10: an order-status query API or tool for agents, shipment/tracking data access, documented post-purchase endpoints or MCP tools, and any hands-on corroboration.
